title: Chrysoeriol: a natural RANKL inhibitor targeting osteoclastogenesis and ROS regulation for osteoporosis therapy.
authors: Luo, Hao; Lin, Sijian; Lv, Hao; Tan, Wen; Zhong, Junlong; Xiong, Jiachao; Liu, ZhiMing; Wu, Qin; Chen, Ming; Cao, Kai
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Chrysoeriol抑制RANKL以治疗骨质疏松，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chrysoeriol (CHE) is a naturally occurring compound with established anti-inflammatory and anti-tumor effects. This study examines its potential role in regulating osteoclast differentiation and activity, both of which are crucial for bone remodeling. Computational docking revealed high binding affinity between CHE and RANKL, specifically at the Lys-181 residue of RANKL, suggesting potential inhibitory interactions on osteoclastogenesis. In vitro assays confirmed CHE's non-toxic profile at concentrations below 20 muM and demonstrated a dose-dependent suppression of osteoclast differentiation. Notably, CHE treatment significantly reduced TRAP activity and bone resorption capacity in a dose-dependent manner. Furthermore, CHE markedly decreased ROS production by NOX-1 expression and modulated the NRF2/KEAP1 pathway to enhance ROS clearance. The compound also showed inhibitory effects on the NF-kappaB and MAPK signaling pathways, which are crucial for osteoclast activation. In an ovariectomized mouse model, administration of CHE mitigated bone loss, indicating its therapeutic potential in osteoporosis. Collectively, these findings establish CHE as a promising natural therapeutic agent for treating bone disorders characterized by excessive bone resorption, underscoring the need for further clinical investigation.
abstract_zh: Chrysoeriol (CHE) 是一种天然化合物，具有公认的抗炎和抗肿瘤作用。本研究探讨其在调节破骨细胞分化和活性中的潜在作用，这两者对骨重塑至关重要。计算对接显示CHE与RANKL之间具有高结合亲和力，特别是在RANKL的Lys-181残基处，提示其对破骨细胞生成具有潜在抑制作用。体外实验证实，CHE在低于20 μM浓度下无毒性，并表现出剂量依赖性抑制破骨细胞分化。值得注意的是，CHE处理显著降低TRAP活性和骨吸收能力，且呈剂量依赖性。此外，CHE通过NOX-1表达显著减少ROS产生，并调节NRF2/KEAP1通路以增强ROS清除。该化合物还对NF-κB和MAPK信号通路表现出抑制作用，这些通路对破骨细胞激活至关重要。在去卵巢小鼠模型中，CHE给药减轻了骨丢失，表明其在骨质疏松症中的治疗潜力。综合来看，这些发现确立了CHE作为一种有前景的天然治疗剂，用于治疗以过度骨吸收为特征的骨疾病，并强调进一步临床研究的必要性。
